warnings: S-04 (roof/tie-beam plan) prints '1.05' left of grid 1 and '1.00' right of grid 2 as the overall tie-beam-plan dimension string, but the traced BS1 tie-beam perimeter itself only connects the 6 main grid points (same rectangle as the RC beams below) — no beam/post was confirmed ending at those outer figures. Read as roof-sheet/eave overhang beyond the last post, not a beam endpoint, so NO x-axis dummy grid was added for them, per the rule against inventing a dummy for an overhang with no structural endpoint. Flagged rather than silently added, since S-04's own drawing is ambiguous about whether CS1 posts exist there too — needs zoom review before fully ruling that out.
'2prime' at 4.80m is a separate, confirmed dummy (ground-floor stair-landing slab extension, S-03, beam BX ends there) — unrelated to the S-04 ambiguity above.
Grid confirmed independently on 3 sheets (S-02 foundation, S-03 column/beam, S-04 roof/tie-beam) — all three agree on the core A/B/C x 1/2 grid (2.70/2.70m rows, 3.60m bay).

Dummy '1'' (single-prime)': beam B1 (S-03 ground-floor plan) sits between grid 1 and grid 2, dividing the A-B room into two S1 slabs, but no dimension line pins its exact x-position anywhere on S-03 or S-07 — recorded with pos_m null rather than guessing the visual midpoint (1.80m). Needs zoom review of S-03 for a dimension this extraction may have missed.

z_levels[] built 2026-08-28 from หน้า09/หน้า10's single element_type:"level" entry, whose four levels were recorded as one prose description ('ระดับดินเดิม ±0.00, ระดับพื้นชั้นล่าง +0.20, ระดับพื้นชั้นบน +2.60, ระดับหลังอเส +5.00') instead of one element per level -- split out verbatim here, nothing computed or added. หน้า10 reprints the identical datum set. dimension_chains[]/unassigned_dimensions[] still un-swept.

RULE-4 FINDING (supersedes the master's own existing warning entry #1, which is now stale): the master file's warning text says S-04 (หน้า22, roof/tie-beam plan) prints '1.05' left of grid 1 and '1.00' right of grid 2 but concluded NO x-axis dummy should be added, reasoning the traced BS1 tie-beam perimeter only connects the 6 main grid points and 'no beam/post was confirmed ending at those outer figures' — citing the pre-2026-09-27 rule that an overhang with no structural endpoint gets no dummy. That rule was explicitly superseded 2026-09-27 (schema §4 rule 4): a printed dimension tick is a line regardless of whether any element sits on it. The same 1.05/1.00 pair is independently printed on FOUR source sheets — roof plan A-06 (หน้า08), section A-A/A-09 (หน้า11, reversed order: 1.00 left of grid2, 1.05 right of grid1 — same two points), and S-04's own beam-plan-tie AND roof-frame-plan views (หน้า22, both views on one image) — and on the roof-frame-plan view the steel rafters (จันทันเหล็ก 2C-100x50x20x3.2mm) are drawn extending all the way to both outer dashed lines, confirming these are real structural endpoints, not just a dimensioning artifact. New x-axis dummies needed: '@-1.05' (grid '1' pos_m 0.0 minus 1.05 = -1.05) and '@4.60' (grid '2' pos_m 3.6 plus 1.00 = 4.60).

RULE-4 FINDING: y-axis overhang '1.20' printed above grid A (roof plan A-06 หน้า08; section B-B/A-10 หน้า12; S-04 both views หน้า22 — 3 distinct source sheets) gives a new dummy before the origin: '@-1.20' (grid 'A' pos_m 0.0 minus 1.20 = -1.20). The matching '1.20' printed BELOW grid C on the same sheets lands exactly on the already-known dummy 'C\'' (pos_m 6.60 = 5.40+1.20) — reused, no new line needed there.

RENAME NEEDED (mechanical — leave to tools/gridfix.py, not done here): per the 'before-origin dummies share the first main grid's prime sequence, primed in reading order' rule, the x-axis sequence now has TWO points in the 'grid 1' family: the new '@-1.05' (before origin) and the existing '1\'' (pos_m 2.3, in the gap after grid 1). Reading order (ascending pos_m) puts -1.05 first, so it should become the new '1\'' and the existing '1\'' (2.3) should be renamed '1\'\''. Similarly on the '2' family: new '@4.60' comes before the existing '2\'' (pos_m 4.8) in reading order, so '@4.60' should become the new '2\'' and the existing '2\'' (4.8) should be renamed '2\'\''. The y-axis new point '@-1.20' has no existing dummy before grid A to collide with, so it simply becomes 'A\'' with no rename needed elsewhere.

CROSS-CHECK on existing master entry: x_lines '1\'' is stored with pos_m 2.3 and confidence_score 0.3 / flag 'pos_unresolved_internal_partition', but the master's own warning text for that line says it was 'recorded with pos_m null rather than guessing' — the stored value (2.3) and the warning text (null) disagree. This sweep independently confirms 2.30 is a genuinely PRINTED value (หน้า07 ground-floor plan shows '2.30' + '1.30' = 3.60 exactly spanning grid 1 to grid 2; หน้า15's WC.1 detail independently shows '1.30' from the same point to grid 2) — not a visual-midpoint guess. Flagging for the master file's own confidence_score/warning text to be revisited; not changed here since this is a staging file only.

DECISION (op_fix, 2026-09-30): หน้า12 (รูปตัด B-B) prints '+2.625' for ห้องนอน/ห้องนั่งเล่น upper-floor rooms, conflicting with the master's existing 'ระดับพื้นชั้นบน' = 2.60 that every other sheet uses for the exact same two rooms (หน้า07, 09, 10, 15, 16, 17, 21, 30, 35 — 9 sheets vs 1). A physical floor slab cannot genuinely sit at two elevations 25mm apart for the same rooms at once — unlike an x/y dummy line (which can be a real second position, e.g. an overhang edge), so this is not treated as a new level per rule 4. Taken as a single drafting rounding slip on the section sheet, not added as a separate dummy z-level; หน้า12's z-chain still resolves through the existing named level 'ระดับพื้นชั้นบน' (2.60). Flagging the '2.625' printed figure here for a human to see, per the never-silently-discard-a-printed-value rule — someone should still glance at the source page once.

z_levels_add note: level_m 0.05 (WC.1 wet-floor sub-level, หน้า07/หน้า11) and 0.10 (ใต้ถุนโล่ง open-undercroft ground level, หน้า06/หน้า07/หน้า12) and 2.50 (stair mid-landing / โล่ง void level, หน้า07/หน้า12/หน้า16/หน้า30/หน้า35) are all genuinely new printed '+X.XX' level call-outs on plan views (not vertical dimension-chain arrows with from/to endpoints), same category the master's existing 4 levels were built from (a single prose element_type:'level' description on หน้า09/10). Recorded once each even though they repeat across several sheets, per the same de-duplication the master already applies to its 4 existing levels.

หน้า06 (site plan) prints its x-axis and y-axis overall boundary dimensions ('8.90', '11.70') with a finer breakdown below/beside that uses the LETTERS 'A' and 'B' (not numbers) as the two outer-segment values — these are the setback CODE labels defined in the sheet's own notes ('A = ไม่น้อยกว่า 2 ม...', 'B = ไม่น้อยกว่า 3 ม...'), not printed numeric dimensions, so no value_m could be assigned to those two segments and no line could be positioned from them (both ends of the outer '8.90'/'11.70' chains are therefore 'edge'-'edge', per the rule for a chain that touches no known line at either end). The A/B setback labels coincidentally reuse the same letters as grid lines 'A'/'B' on this house — a source-drawing convention, not a naming collision in this dataset (context makes the two clearly distinct: one is a callout letter on a setback dimension line, the other is a circled grid-line marker).

หน้า35 (electrical lighting/outlet floor plans) prints only the coarse grid string (1→2: 3.60; A→B/B→C: 2.70 each) with no overhang segments (no 1.20/1.05/1.00) and no cumulative 5.40 bracket, unlike every other full-plan sheet in this set — consistent with an electrical layer sheet that doesn't need the roof-overhang or cumulative dimensions, not a sign of a different grid.

Pages 17, 18, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 31_view1, and 32 were opened and visually checked (not skipped by pattern name alone) since their pattern tags ('section', 'etc_plan') can carry real grid data on this house — as หน้า15 and หน้า16 (also 'section'/'etc_plan') turned out to. All nine were confirmed to be pure member/fixture/assembly details with no A/B/C or 1/2 grid marks printed anywhere on the sheet; see pages_skipped for the per-page reasoning.

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 1' -> 1'', 2' -> 2''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names
